question: Should design start on request-less gate rooms by default with a provider opt-in at prepare, coherent with subspace q0's finalizing journey?

artifacts.summary: Seed from the captain's 2026-08-25 gate-format review. Facts: 499/499 rooms carry request.json; only ~8 July-era provider results ever consumed one; every field it carries is either already in the frontmatter binding or a hardcoded constant. q0 (subspace repo, at validation) finalizes the provider journey that makes the file real: subspace-tui preflights the frozen request; gate record --room cross-checks resolution.by == request.approver. Seed design: chat default = one-file room (existing empty-request-digest validator path); provider opt-in mints today's exact bytes; drop unused per-item type; mediaType held behind cross-repo agreement (q0's Result echoes it). Ideation spikes q0's preflight against both room shapes. internal/gates = high-stakes surface: detached audit applies.
